category_title: English-dominant Chinese immigrant students with ADHD and Chinese language learning difficulties
scenario_title: Chinese language class work and pacing pressure
minimal_context: Eric is in an individual lesson working on a worksheet where he needs to use Chinese words to make sentences in writing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Eric, it is time for your individual lesson. Please look at this worksheet and use these Chinese words to make sentences in writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves about in his seat and begins biting his finger while looking at the Chinese words.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your worksheet so that you can progress at the same pace as your peers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues moving about anxiously and bites his finger harder, looking increasingly agitated.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am reminding you again that you need to focus. We have to cover the same amount of content as the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pulls his hair and screams in frustration.)

task.content: doing Chinese language class work or quizzes... complete a work sheet using the words to make sentences in writing
task.learning_goal: improve and ensure learning of the Chinese language

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: exhibited anxiety and anger through moving about and finger biting
